description: Land Acquisition - Mahena, Warakapola D/S Division, Kegalle District - Delgamuwa, Warakapola D/S Division, Kegalle District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices for acquiring specific land parcels (including lot numbers, descriptions, extents, and locations) for public purposes. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" including "land acquisitions" as specified in Type 4 classification, and appears in "PART III - LANDS" section of the gazette.
